parameters.description: The ID of the report to export.
parameters.name: reportId

exportType.description:
The type of export to perform. Valid values are:
- `SCREENSHOT`: Screenshot of the report.
- `CSV`: ZIP with one or more CSV files.
- `XLS`: ZIP with one or more XLS files.
- `XLSX: ZIP with one or more XLSX files.

message.description: The message to include with the export. Optional, empty by default.

recipientUserIds.description: Array of user IDs to send the export to. If absent or empty, the requesting user is used as the sole recipient; otherwise, this exact set of users is used.

subject.description: The subject line to use for the export. If absent, the name of the requested report will be used. Max length of 100 characters.

paging.description: Represents the pagination information for navigating through a list of results in the API. It provides details on how to access the previous or next set of results.

next.description: Specifies the paging information needed to retrieve the next set of results in a paginated API response

after.description: A string token representing the cursor for the next page of results.

link.description: A string URL that links to the next page of results.

prev.description: specifies the paging information needed to retrieve the previous set of results in a paginated API response

before.description: A string token representing the cursor for the previous page of results.

link.description: A string URL that links to the previous page of results.

archivedAt.description: If the report is archived, the date and time when the report was archived, in ISO 8601 format. Absent if the report is not archived.

businessUnitId.description: The ID of the business unit that the report is associated with.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the report was created, in ISO 8601 format.

createdByUserId.description: The ID of the user who created the report. May be absent.

description.description: A description of the report. May be absent.

lastViewedAt.description: The date and time when the report was last viewed, in ISO 8601 format. Absent if it has not been viewed yet.

lastViewedByUserId.description: The ID of the user who last viewed the report. Absent if it has not been viewed yet.

ownerUserId.description: The ID of the user who owns the report. Absent if the report is currently unowned.

permissionType.description:
The type of permission to apply to the report. Valid values are:
- PRIVATE: The report is only accessible to its owner and administrators.
- EVERYONE_VIEW: The report is viewable by everyone.
- EVERYONE_EDIT: The report is viewable and editable by everyone.
- SPECIFIC: In addition to the owner, specific users and/or teams are granted VIEW or EDIT permissions. The `specificPermissions` field must also be present.

grants.description: An array of grants detailing the users and/or teams to grant the specific permission to. At least one grantee must be specified.

grantType.description: The type of entity to grant permissions to, either `USER` or `TEAM`.

granteeId.description: The ID of the user or team to grant permissions to.

permissionType.description: The type of permission granted, either `VIEW` or `EDIT`.

tags.description:
Array of objects representing the tags that the report is tagged with.

Only returned when requested by including the `tags` field in the `properties` query parameter.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the tag was created, in ISO 8601 format. May be absent.

createdByUserId.description: The ID of the user who created the tag. May be absent.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when the tag was last updated, in ISO 8601 format. May be absent.

updatedByUserId.description: The ID of the user who last updated the tag. May be absent.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when the report was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

updatedByUserId.description: The ID of the user who last updated the report. May be absent.

total.description: The total number of reports available.
